name: delete-refusal-semantics
body: `apg project delete <name>` must refuse — naming the actual state and one fix command — unless the project's branch is safe to remove: `<name>` is a valid project name; the branch exists and is not the default branch; the branch is not the main checkout's current branch; the branch is checked out in the project's own worktree at `<main>/apg/.worktrees/<name>` (leftover-branch and mismatched-worktree states are refused with a manual fix, never guessed); and the worktree has no tracked uncommitted changes (commit/stash first). Delete does NOT require the branch to be merged — discarding an unmerged branch is its purpose.
